steps.step: SPP1 brute force (3 modes, random BdG slices with pairing, random unitaries, three of six with an eigenvalue -1): the sign-exact path continuation f_U = Tr[Gamma(u) X] / Tr[X] and the stabilised f_U g_U(tau) = Tr[Gamma(u) X_A O X_C O^dag] / Tr[X] equal the Fock-space traces
steps.detail: max rel. error 3.0e-14 over 6 configurations x (1 trace + 3 cuts)

steps.step: SPP2 free limit of the production operator (twisted cubic16, lambda = 0.39, beta = 1, g = 0): f_U and g_U(tau) from the production path for all 64 elements (16 twisted translations x Z4) equal the closed forms det(1 + u e^{-beta h}) / det(1 + e^{-beta h}) and tr Pi^dag e^{-tau h} (1 + u e^{-beta h})^-1 Pi / 16
steps.detail: max rel. error f 3.2e-12, max abs. error g 2.4e-15; path steps per configuration 192

steps.step: SPP3 symmetry of the twisted production operator (cubic16, lambda = 0.39): the twisted translations u_a = G^-1 (P_a x 1) G commute with H_w, form a representation, are diagonal in the common plane-wave basis F, and map every HS composite B_{iA} into span{B_{pi(i) B}} with a real orthogonal 10 x 10 matrix (a Spin(10) Cartan rotation) -- with the isotropic Gaussian prior the HS-averaged slice commutes with all 64 sector elements (Z4: as in ST4)
steps.detail: [u_a, H_w] 1.0e-15 (gauge sign -1), representation 2.5e-16, diagonal in F 1.3e-15, composite covariance 3.8e-14, orthogonality / reality 7.7e-14

steps.step: SPP4 interacting configuration (g = 0.018, lambda = 0.39, beta = 1, HS field 3x the prior width): the U = 1 term reproduces greens_k at every measured tau, and f_U^2 from the sign-exact path equals the independent determinant ratio det(u) det(mid_U) / det(mid_1) at three cuts l (stabilisation and the det(u) factor)
steps.detail: U = 1 vs greens_k 8.3e-16; f^2 vs det ratio 1.0e-12; |f_U| range 8.25e-37..1.00; path steps 5617

steps.step: SPP5 (statement) production at the GROUND_CONNECTED_3BETA_CANDIDATE branch (cubic16, Q+ at P + lambda (1,1,1)): sector fractions D_r = Z_r / Z (direct sector traces), reference sector (largest D_r), absolute start-sector projected C_r(tau) at the predeclared fixed tau, the unprojected sum (= ordinary G), the free (g = 0) closed-form reference at the same beta and twist (the sector distribution concentrates in the free system only for beta >~ 6-8: lowest free |eps| = 0.53) and the first-order HF quasi-particle model (16 mirror modes moved to |e| ~ 0.01 at g = 0.018) -- the direct sector traces test whether near-zero modes exist, independent of the operator
